payload.title: Operations hygiene as an agent
payload.description:
One daily agent, tier `work` with most of its work in code: reads the due indexes for anything Overdue and re-sends the wake; checks the dead-letter queues; reports failed deploys by reading the job log (never retrying); lists runs still `unknown`; reports spend against budget. It writes flags and nothing else. It never retries a deploy, never purges a cache, never touches AWS resources.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Each morning's Today has a hygiene line: clean, or what needs a person.
- It changes nothing but flags and re-sent wakes.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- ops-hygiene-agent.feature: a clean day ends `nothing`; an overdue record is re-woken once and flagged; a dead-lettered wake is reported; it never retries a deploy.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Read access to queue depths and the deploy job log.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M8 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
